operations.description: CRTFtol(a1) truncates the float input to an integer.
Multiply the truncated value by 0.00027777778 (1/3600) and truncate again, yielding the count of whole 3600-unit 'hours' in the input.
Write the whole-hour count to the output pointer a2.
Subtract the whole hours converted back to input units (hours * 3600.0) from a1 to get the residual value.
Call SpatialGridCell(residual, a3, a4) and return its result; the grid cell is computed from the residual part only.
